Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 125: August 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #125 shipped to subscribers in July 2011 (bearing the cover date of August 2011 for Issue 125). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #125 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron (third-person action-adventure)
Driver: San Francisco (action-driving adventure)
NHL 12 (sports simulation)
BloodRayne: Betrayal (Xbox Live Arcade 2D side-scrolling hack-and-slash)
Renegade Ops (Xbox Live Arcade top-down vehicular combat)
Radiant Silvergun (Xbox Live Arcade arcade shoot 'em up remaster)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Gears of War 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
